reason: A DeepSeek Harness web client plugin that detects Mermaid code blocks in chat messages and renders them as diagrams with source toggling, rerendering, and theme-aware display.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端中将聊天消息里的 Mermaid 代码块渲染为图表，并支持图表与源码切换、重新渲染及主题同步。
summaries.en: Renders Mermaid code blocks in DeepSeek Harness chat messages as diagrams with chart/source toggling, rerendering, and theme synchronization.

capabilities: Renders Mermaid code blocks as diagrams in the web client
Modifies chat code-block controls to provide chart/source toggling and rerendering
Loads Mermaid from cdn.jsdelivr.net on first render
Observes streaming DOM changes and injects client-side styles
